Search APIs¶

The gal.search package hosts the modular branch-and-bound engine used by active-learning routines and benchmarks. It exports the high-level search_pair helper alongside composable bounds and visiting strategies.

GAL search package.

Parameters:

  • wc (numpy.ndarray) – Weighting coefficients defining the optimisation direction.
